headline: Attraction Entry and Performance Ticket Considerations
reservation: While most public monuments in Memphis do not require permits, major attractions like Graceland utilize timed-entry tickets that should be purchased online to ensure availability. The National Civil Rights Museum also recommends advance booking during holiday weekends. Note that restaurant reservations for popular barbecue spots are rarely accepted, so prepare for local wait times.

days.title: Blues Heritage and Civil Rights

stops.name: National Civil Rights Museum
stops.detail: Built at the site of the Lorraine Motel, this museum tracks the history of the American Civil Rights Movement.

stops.name: Beale Street Historic District
stops.detail: Walk the iconic neon-lit street during the day to visit the W.C. Handy House Museum and local music landmarks.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes for downtown transit; walking is feasible between these central sites.
days.note: Beale Street has security checkpoints and age restrictions on certain evenings.

days.title: Musical Legends and the Mighty Mississippi
days.start: Suggested: 9:30 AM from the Medical District

stops.name: Sun Studio
stops.detail: Take a guided tour of the recording studio where rock and roll was pioneered by artists like Elvis Presley and Johnny Cash.

stops.name: Big River Crossing
stops.detail: Walk across the Harahan Bridge for panoramic views of the Mississippi River and the Memphis skyline.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for cross-city travel; conditions vary during weekday rush hours.
days.note: Sun Studio tours often sell out early in the day; arrive early to secure a slot.

days.title: Rock n' Soul History
days.start: Suggested: 10:00 AM from Elvis Presley Blvd

stops.name: Graceland
stops.detail: Tour the mansion and grounds of the Elvis Presley estate, including the Meditation Garden and car museum.

stops.name: Stax Museum of American Soul Music
stops.detail: Located at the original site of Stax Records, this museum celebrates the legacy of soul music legends.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes to travel between Whitehaven and the Soulsville neighborhood.
days.note: Allot at least four hours for a comprehensive visit to the Graceland complex.

intel.title: Downtown Garages
intel.text: The garage at Peabody Place is central for downtown exploring. Avoid leaving valuables in vehicles even in paid, monitored lots.

intel.title: City Connectivity
intel.text: Signal is robust across the metro area. Use local Wi-Fi in the South Main Arts District for transit updates.

intel.title: Suburban Corridors
intel.text: Fuel stations are plentiful along I-240 and Poplar Avenue. Prices are generally lower away from the immediate downtown core.

intel.title: The Peabody Ducks
intel.text: The daily march at The Peabody Memphis occurs at 11 AM and 5 PM. Arrive at least thirty minutes early to secure a view in the lobby.

intel.title: Riverfront Pedestrians
intel.text: Mud Island Park access can change based on river levels and seasonal maintenance. Check the city park's website for bridge walk status.

plan.arrival: After arriving at MEM, a 20-minute drive north brings you to downtown. Pick up supplies at the grocery stores in Midtown before checking into your hotel.
plan.vehicle: Standard sedans are ideal for city driving. RVs may find downtown parking challenging; look for designated lots near Mud Island or Graceland.
plan.goldenHour: Martyrs' Park overlooking the Hernando de Soto Bridge; evening illumination varies by season.
